searchText: Could anyone recommend any more reading or information on this topic? I think I have all the info about it, but I just want to make sure I am up to date on it <@!181920051333431296> what exactly are you interested in? The EIPs (EIP-2718 + EIP-2930 + EIP-2929) and their `discussions-to` links are where the majority of the conversation was I just wanted to know if was missing information on any other proposed transaction types yet. This is cool its still in its early stages. Thank you for your help right now, i think 1559 is the only other tx type in active development
